numerical_recomputation.notes: All printed orders, durations, capacities, control counts, Boolean drill results, recovery tuple, and readiness outcome reproduce under the repository snippet verifier.

evidence: Verified earliest finish is duration plus maximum predecessor finish and therefore honors fan-in without double-counting parallel branches.
Verified componentwise capacity admissibility requires demand plus live/recovery/overhead reserve within every enforced resource limit; one violated dimension rejects readiness.
Verified SLI validity depends on explicit eligible population and missing-data handling, since silently removing missing obligations biases the good fraction.
Verified conjunctive readiness blocks on any unknown/false critical contract, capacity, control, security, publication, recovery, or ownership obligation even if an average score is high.
Verified code/process rollback does not imply reversal of data/external effects and therefore cannot replace generation/consumer reconciliation.

evidence: The executable is labeled a finite arithmetic/completeness demonstration that does not measure production, validate semantics, test people, or prove an SLO.
Google SRE monitoring, SLO, alerting, pipeline, integrity, and testing practices are adapted to data products rather than asserted as universal constants.
Airflow task/health mechanisms are product-scoped and explicitly separated from sink guarantees and consumer-product health.
OpenTelemetry and OpenLineage are presented as diagnostic/lineage correlation that complements rather than replaces authoritative operational state.
Kubernetes probe semantics are used to distinguish actions and include the documented warning about harmful liveness configuration, not as proof of workflow readiness.
